closingRationale: Emission/measurement slice: distance-to-threshold measurements on the existing gate-result envelope, a pure quadratic per-gate loss, accumulation, a leading-indicator alarm, and dogfood emission from this repo's traceability + perf gates. Outcome-data calibration (acceptance criterion 3) and a persisted cross-period telemetry store + dashboard trend panel are deliberately deferred as tracked follow-ups, so Refs (not Closes).
assumptions: Emission/measurement only — no gate pass/fail or exitCode logic changed; the CICheckResult.measurements field is additive and absent when empty
Continuous distance-to-threshold added to the existing CICheckResult envelope (packages/types) rather than a parallel schema
Per-gate loss = quadratic (proximity^2), normalized so proximity==1 at the threshold and comparable across gates; robust to divide-by-zero / non-finite (clamped + degraded flag, never NaN/Infinity)
Dogfood gates chosen: traceability coverage (lower bound, emitted even while green = the leading indicator) and perf complexity/coupling (upper bound)
Outcome-data calibration and persisted cross-period telemetry/dashboard trend panel are out of scope for this slice
